A '''species''' with red eyes, yellow claws, and a tail could be found on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] and in the [[Desert/Legends|deserts]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. They moved by propelling themselves with their large pincers, using them to jump into the air.<ref name="Super Star Wars: Return of the Jedi" />
